lines.zh: 沙丘在我甲片下沙沙作响
lines.en: The dunes hiss beneath my plated hide.

lines.zh: 我沿着恶地的红岩边缘巡逻
lines.en: I patrol the red rock rim of the badlands.

lines.zh: 每一步都压出深陷的沙坑
lines.en: Each stride sinks a deep pit in the sand.

lines.zh: 甲片缝隙里塞满滚烫的沙粒
lines.en: Hot sand lodges in the seams of my plates.

lines.zh: 烈日把我的盔甲晒得发白
lines.en: The high sun bleaches my armor pale.

lines.zh: 我走过干涸河床，留下爪痕
lines.en: I cross dry riverbeds, leaving claw marks.

lines.zh: 风把我的脚印很快抹掉
lines.en: The wind erases my footprints almost at once.

lines.zh: 仙人掌替我遮住半边身子
lines.en: A cactus shields half of my body.

lines.zh: 带甲的肩膀撞开枯死的灌木
lines.en: My armored shoulder shoves dead brush aside.

lines.zh: 恶地的热气让甲片发烫
lines.en: Badlands heat cooks the plates on my back.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石，缓缓逼近绿洲
lines.en: I crunch over gravel, closing on the oasis.

lines.zh: 沙漠很大，而我是它的守卫
lines.en: The desert is vast, and I am its guard.

lines.zh: 我蹲在沙里，只露出甲背
lines.en: I squat in the sand with only my shell showing.

lines.zh: 我用前肢抹去甲片上的沙
lines.en: I scrape sand off my plates with a forelimb.

lines.zh: 吞咽声在我喉咙深处滚动
lines.en: A slow swallow rolls deep in my throat.

lines.zh: 我在热风里一动不动地等着
lines.en: I wait motionless in the hot wind.

lines.zh: 甲片互相摩擦，发出干涩响声
lines.en: My plates grind with a dry rasp.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处那株孤零零的枯树
lines.en: I stare at a lone dead tree far off.

lines.zh: 我呼吸时，胸甲轻轻起伏
lines.en: My chest plate rises and falls as I breathe.

lines.zh: 沙粒钻进关节，我不去管它
lines.en: Sand works into my joints; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔干裂的口器
lines.en: I lick my cracked mouthparts.

lines.zh: 我把身体埋得更深一点
lines.en: I sink my body a little deeper.

lines.zh: 你站得那么直，像是来送甲的
lines.en: You stand so straight, like a delivery of armor.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一步也没漏
lines.en: I count your footsteps and miss none.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进沙里，声音很脆
lines.en: Your boots crackle as they sink into sand.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，甲片缝里露出目光
lines.en: I lift my head; my gaze shows between plates.

lines.zh: 你不该在恶地这样闲逛
lines.en: You should not wander the badlands so idly.

lines.zh: 我记住你腰上那把短剑
lines.en: I note the short sword at your hip.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我看见了
lines.en: You stepped back half a pace; I saw.

lines.zh: 烈日下你的影子缩得很短
lines.en: Your shadow shrinks short under the noon sun.

lines.zh: 我歪头打量你的护腿
lines.en: I tilt my head and study your legguards.

lines.zh: 你在找我的核心吗，人类
lines.en: Are you hunting my guardian core, human?

lines.zh: 我的甲比你的铁片厚得多
lines.en: My plates are far thicker than your iron.

lines.zh: 别把手伸向背后，我看得见
lines.en: Do not reach behind you; I can see it.

lines.zh: 甲片挡住了，可里面还是疼
lines.en: The plate stopped it, but it still hurts inside.

lines.zh: 谁在我甲背上敲了一下
lines.en: Someone rapped my shell from behind.

lines.zh: 这点力道，连沙暴都比不上
lines.en: This much? A sandstorm hits harder.

lines.zh: 我的甲裂了一道缝
lines.en: A crack opened in my armor.

lines.zh: 你打中关节了，好眼力
lines.en: You hit my joint; sharp eyes.

lines.zh: 旧伤又醒了，真会挑时候
lines.en: My old wound wakes at a bad moment.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，只是调整
lines.en: I stepped back, merely adjusting.

lines.zh: 沙里混进了我的血
lines.en: My blood is mixing with the sand.

lines.zh: 别以为裂甲就等于倒下
lines.en: A cracked plate is not a fallen beast.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把疼咽回去
lines.en: I clamp my jaw and swallow the pain.

lines.zh: 食物？沙漠里没什么值得我张嘴
lines.en: Food? Nothing here is worth opening my jaw.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西骗不了壳里的我
lines.en: Whatever you hold cannot fool a thing in a shell.

lines.zh: 我只对会动的东西有兴趣
lines.en: I only care about things that move.

lines.zh: 把食物收起来，我不吃施舍
lines.en: Put it away; I take no handouts.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉，我的甲片都没动
lines.en: You wave that meat; not one plate of mine stirs.

lines.zh: 沙漠教会我，诱饵都有钩
lines.en: The desert taught me every bait hides a hook.

lines.zh: 我宁愿啃带沙的仙人掌
lines.en: I would rather chew a gritty cactus.

lines.zh: 你身上的汗味比那块肉有用
lines.en: Your sweat interests me more than that meat.

lines.zh: 别拿食物试探一只老兵
lines.en: Do not test a veteran with scraps.

lines.zh: 饥饿我忍得住，贪心忍不住
lines.en: I can bear hunger; I cannot bear greed.

lines.zh: 撞上来？我的甲可不讲道理
lines.en: Bumping me? My plates do not negotiate.

lines.zh: 你撞得我肩甲响了一声
lines.en: You knocked a clang out of my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 退开，别贴着我走
lines.en: Back off; do not walk against me.

lines.zh: 我的体重压得沙子往下陷
lines.en: My weight pushes the sand down under us.

lines.zh: 再挤一次，我就用头甲顶你
lines.en: Push once more and my head plate answers.

lines.zh: 甲片刮过你的皮革，声音刺耳
lines.en: My plate scrapes your leather with a grating sound.

lines.zh: 沙漠很宽，不必和我抢路
lines.en: The desert is wide; you need not share my path.

lines.zh: 你撞疼自己了，不是我
lines.en: You hurt yourself on me, not the reverse.

lines.zh: 让开，我正赶去守水点
lines.en: Step aside; I am bound for the water hole.

lines.zh: 我这身甲，从来不让路
lines.en: This armor of mine has never stepped aside.

lines.zh: 旱季里，我顾不上找同伴
lines.en: In the dry season I have no time for a mate.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，先比甲再说话
lines.en: When kin meet, we compare plates before words.

lines.zh: 我的气味留在界石上
lines.en: My scent stays on the boundary stones.

lines.zh: 配对要靠甲片撞击的响度
lines.en: Pairing is settled by how loud our plates clash.

lines.zh: 沙暴要来了，谁也没空谈情
lines.en: A sandstorm comes; no one courts in that.

lines.zh: 我独自守这片沙丘很久了
lines.en: I have held this dune alone a long while.

lines.zh: 等雨季过去，我再去找她
lines.en: When the rains pass, I will go find her.

lines.zh: 同族的甲纹，我一眼认得出
lines.en: I know my kin by the grain of their plates.

lines.zh: 伴侣要能一起扛住热风
lines.en: A mate must weather the hot wind beside me.

lines.zh: 甲壳相碰，比叫声更可信
lines.en: Shell against shell says more than any call.

lines.zh: 这块甲片，是我蜕下来的
lines.en: This shard is one I shed.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，沙漠不白给
lines.en: I collect nothing; the desert gives nothing free.

lines.zh: 你把碎片收好，别丢在沙里
lines.en: Keep those shards; do not leave them in the sand.

lines.zh: 掉落之物，自会有人来取
lines.en: What falls will be claimed by someone.

lines.zh: 我不用手捡，我用颚叼
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I carry them in my mandibles.

lines.zh: 这枚核心，不该躺在沙上
lines.en: This core should not lie on open sand.

lines.zh: 甲壳留着，能替你挡一刀
lines.en: Keep the shell; it will stop a blade for you.

lines.zh: 沙下的东西，比地上的值钱
lines.en: What lies under the sand is worth more.

lines.zh: 别弯腰捡，我会以为你要扑
lines.en: Do not stoop to grab; I might read it as a lunge.

lines.zh: 我的碎片，只会从尸体上掉
lines.en: My shards only drop off a corpse.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在沙上震得太响
lines.en: Your heartbeat pounds too loudly on the sand.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，别再装作石头
lines.en: I see you; stop pretending to be a rock.

lines.zh: 恶地的风把你送到我面前
lines.en: The badlands wind delivered you to me.

lines.zh: 甲片竖起，我要开始了
lines.en: My plates rise; I am beginning.

lines.zh: 这一带的路，收费是血
lines.en: Passage here costs blood.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的领地了，人类
lines.en: You stepped into my ground, human.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的镐，够了
lines.en: I saw the pick in your hand; that is enough.

lines.zh: 远方那个影子，我锁定了
lines.en: That shape in the distance is marked.

lines.zh: 沙漠里的猎物，跑不过我
lines.en: No prey outruns me across open sand.

lines.zh: 我的关节咔咔作响，你听见了
lines.en: Hear my joints crack into place?

lines.zh: 你用不着拔剑，先站稳
lines.en: No need to draw; just find your footing.

lines.zh: 盯住你，是我今天的活
lines.en: Watching you is today's work.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着的骨头，都是先例
lines.en: The bones under this sand set a precedent.

lines.zh: 你走进来了，就别想走
lines.en: You walked in; you will not walk out.

lines.zh: 沙里传来你的脚步，很沉。
lines.en: Your steps come through the sand, heavy.

lines.zh: 我抬起前肢，甲片张开。
lines.en: I lift my forelimbs and the plates open.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，甲缘贴住地面
lines.en: I lower myself, plate rim against the ground.

lines.zh: 你的侧步我全看在眼里
lines.en: I see every sidestep you take.

lines.zh: 沙会拖慢你，不会拖慢我
lines.en: Sand slows you, never me.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子，等你先动
lines.en: I circle, waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你喘得急，沙都吸进肺里
lines.en: You are panting; sand is in your lungs.

lines.zh: 退到仙人掌那边也没用
lines.en: Retreating to the cactus helps nothing.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里没有破绽
lines.en: There is no gap in my plates.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我就换方向
lines.en: Raise your shield and I change angle.

lines.zh: 一步，两步，你踩到软沙了
lines.en: One step, two: you found the soft sand.

lines.zh: 别看我脚下，看我的肩
lines.en: Do not watch my feet; watch my shoulder.

lines.zh: 热气在晃，我的影子也在晃
lines.en: Heat shimmers; so does my shadow.

lines.zh: 我耐得住等，你耐不住
lines.en: I can outlast the wait; you cannot.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就进两步
lines.en: One step back from you is two from me.

lines.zh: 我的目标很简单：你的膝
lines.en: My target is simple: your knees.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面横移半步。
lines.en: I slide half a step across the sand.

lines.zh: 你退到枯树边，我绕过去。
lines.en: You back to the dead tree; I go around.

lines.zh: 热风把你的味道送来了。
lines.en: The hot wind carries your scent to me.

lines.zh: 甲肩压下来，像半堵墙
lines.en: My plated shoulder comes down like half a wall.

lines.zh: 颚钳咬住，别指望挣开
lines.en: My mandibles close; do not count on slipping free.

lines.zh: 这一撞，足够你记住恶地
lines.en: This charge will teach you the badlands.

lines.zh: 你格挡的角度偏了三指
lines.en: Your block was three fingers off.

lines.zh: 沙尘里我照样能打准
lines.en: Even in a dust cloud I strike true.

lines.zh: 甲片擦过你的护胸，留了印
lines.en: My plate scored your cuirass.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁，没路了
lines.en: You back into the rock face; no road left.

lines.zh: 这记横扫是我从沙暴里学的
lines.en: I learned this sweep in a sandstorm.

lines.zh: 血流在热沙上，很快就干
lines.en: Blood dries fast on hot sand.

lines.zh: 我咬穿你的皮甲，听见了
lines.en: I bit through your leather; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你的剑弹开了，我没事
lines.en: Your blade glanced off; I am unhurt.

lines.zh: 站稳，第二下比第一下重
lines.en: Stand firm; the second blow is heavier.

lines.zh: 我用头甲顶你的胸口
lines.en: I drive my head plate into your chest.

lines.zh: 这就是守卫的价格
lines.en: That is the guard's price.

lines.zh: 头甲撞上你的护腿。
lines.en: My head plate crashes into your leggings.

lines.zh: 颚钳合拢，你的靴子裂了。
lines.en: My jaws close and your boot splits.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘背面爬出来
lines.en: I crawl up from behind the dune.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土裂开，我出来了
lines.en: The red earth cracks open; I am out.

lines.zh: 沙子从我甲片上簌簌滑落
lines.en: Sand slithers off my plates in streams.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠又多了个守卫
lines.en: This desert has a new guard.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先数了一遍地平线
lines.en: I open my eyes and count the horizon.

lines.zh: 热风把新甲片吹得发亮
lines.en: The hot wind polishes my fresh plates.

lines.zh: 我从裂缝里出来，带着旧伤
lines.en: I rise from the fissure, carrying old scars.

lines.zh: 谁在恶地吵醒了我
lines.en: Who woke me out in the badlands?

lines.zh: 我的第一件事是找水点
lines.en: My first errand is to find the water hole.

lines.zh: 沙子记得我上次来过
lines.en: The sand remembers my last visit.

lines.zh: 我在正午出生，光很刺眼
lines.en: I was born at noon, and the light stung.

lines.zh: 行走的甲，又回到这片沙
lines.en: The walking armor returns to this sand.

lines.zh: 甲片被烧得发红，我受不了
lines.en: My plates glow red; I cannot bear fire.

lines.zh: 落地那一下，甲片全在响
lines.en: On landing, every plate of mine rings.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，水灌进甲缝
lines.en: I cannot swim; water pours into my seams.

lines.zh: 冲击从甲缝挤进来，太闷了
lines.en: Blast squeezes through my seams; too much.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝里，拔不出来
lines.en: An arrow is wedged in my seams.

lines.zh: 魔法穿过甲片，直接咬我骨
lines.en: Magic ignores my plates and bites the bone.

lines.zh: 沙漠饿起人来，比敌人狠
lines.en: Desert hunger is crueler than any foe.

lines.zh: 雷打在我甲上，像烧红的锤
lines.en: Lightning on my plates, like a red-hot hammer.

lines.zh: 脚下没有沙了，这不对劲
lines.en: No sand under me; something is wrong.
